title: AccountingHub's own Payment Terms list is untouched
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the organization uses AccountingHub; before the case, the Payment Terms list in Accounting Settings was written down.
  • Choose a new name for term A that no term has.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type the name of term A in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Create Credit Term".
  5. Open Accounting Settings, Payment Terms.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window opens.

Step 2:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 3:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 4:

  • The toast "term A created" shows.

Step 5:

  • The list is exactly as written down.
  • Term A does not appear there.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • Out of Scope: “Merging with AccountingHub's own Payment Terms list. AccountingHub keeps its separate Payment Terms list (Accounting Settings). A merge waits until AccountingHub's term rules are confirmed (follow-up, open question on the review page).”
